name: Courage the Cowardly Dog
description: The bizarre misadventures of a cowardly dog named Courage and his elderly owners in a farmhouse in Nowhere, Kansas.

videos.title: The Chicken from Outer Space
videos.overview: A chicken from outer space fights Courage, while Muriel cooks Eustace some strange eggs for breakfast that she got from the outerspace chicken. Eustace turns into a chicken, and Courage shoots both the alien chicken and the Eustace chicken with a laser gun.

videos.title: The Wind Whispers Courage
videos.overview: Two music video promos aired during Cartoon Cartoon Weekend Summerfest. One was called "The Wind Whispers Courage," which was about a lady named Kitten (a singer), who comes to Courage's house and sings about him.

videos.title: They Might Be Giants
videos.overview: Two teddy bears in a spaceship land on Earth to look for a worm. One is quite handy with a laser gun. Courage plays the horn and it attracts a worm, which just happens to be the worm that the teddy bears are after. When Muriel won't tell them where it is, and the teddy bears blow up part of their house. The worm comes and it turns out he is a giant blue worm from outer space that eats the teddy bears as well as Muriel. The worm belongs to a giant...

videos.title: The Fog of Courage
videos.overview: When Courage finds a mysterious amulet while digging through the yard, a Ghostly Fog covers the farmhouse. Eustace, however, refuses to return the amulet that apparently belongs to the Fog Ghost's long lost love. Now Courage must protect his family from the vengeful fog spirit.

videos.title: A Night at the Katz Motel
videos.overview: Courage, Muriel and Eustace check into a motel run by a sinister cat.

videos.title: Cajun Granny Stew
videos.overview: A fox searches for the missing ingredient for his Cajun Granny Stew.

videos.title: The Shadow of Courage
videos.overview: A shadow escapes from an evil, rich old man and descends on the farm.

videos.title: Dr. Le Quack, Amnesia Specialist
videos.overview: When Muriel gets amnesia, Courage hires a French duck to help.

videos.title: Courage Meets Bigfoot
videos.overview: A hungry bigfoot shows up at the farm.

videos.title: Hothead
videos.overview: Eustace drags Courage to an institute that promises hair growth.

videos.title: The Demon in the Mattress
videos.overview: Muriel's mattress has a demon.

videos.title: Freaky Fred
videos.overview: Muriel's nephew visits the farm.

videos.title: Night of the Weremole
videos.overview: Courage must find an antidote when Muriel is bitten.

videos.title: Mother's Day
videos.overview: Eustace takes Courage with him when he visits his mother on Mother's Day.

videos.title: The Duck Brothers
videos.overview: Duck brothers from outer space kidnap Muriel.

videos.title: Shirley the Medium
videos.overview: Eustace hires a medium to channel his brother's spirit.

videos.title: King Ramses' Curse
videos.overview: Courage discovers an ancient artifact that was stolen from a museum.

videos.title: The Clutching Foot
videos.overview: Eustace's foot is infected with a fungus.

videos.title: The Hunchback of Nowhere
videos.overview: Much to Eustace's chagrin, Courage befriends a hunchback.

videos.title: The Gods Must Be Goosey
videos.overview: A lonely goose god wants Muriel for his queen.

videos.title: Queen of the Black Puddle
videos.overview: A puddle queen woos Eustace into her puddle world.

videos.title: Everyone Wants to Direct
videos.overview: Eustace unwittingly agrees to allow a zombie director to film at the farm.

videos.title: The Snowman Cometh
videos.overview: While vacationing in the Arctic, the trio encounters an evil snowman.

videos.title: The Precious, Wonderful, Adorable, Lovable Duckling
videos.overview: A little duckling claims Eustace as its mother.

videos.title: Heads of Beef
videos.overview: Eustace and Courage go into town for hamburgers.

videos.title: Klub Katz
videos.overview: When Courage, Eustace and Muriel are on an island, they encounter Katz.

videos.title: The Revenge of the Chicken from Outer Space
videos.overview: The chicken from outer space returns to seek revenge on Courage.

videos.title: Journey to the Center of Nowhere
videos.overview: An army of angry eggplants plan to attack Muriel.

videos.title: Little Muriel
videos.overview: A tornado destroys the farmhouse and turns Muriel into a 3-year-old girl.

videos.title: The Great Fusilli
videos.overview: An evil stage-master turns Muriel and Eustace into puppets.

videos.title: The Magic Tree of Nowhere
videos.overview: Muriel plants a magic tree that makes wishes come true.

videos.title: Robot Randy
videos.overview: Robot Randy is sent to Earth to conquer it and prove his merit.

videos.title: The Curse of Shirley
videos.overview: Shirley's curse on Eustace can only be undone if he learns to give of himself.

videos.title: Courage in the Big Stinkin' City
videos.overview: Muriel is invited to play her sitar at Radio City Music Hall.

videos.title: Family Business
videos.overview: A burglar mistakes the family for his relatives and decides they should pull a heist.

videos.title: 1000 Years of Courage
videos.overview: The family is buried under a thousand years of sediment.

videos.title: Courage Meets the Mummy
videos.overview: A mummy seeks revenge on the two people who wrongfully entombed him.

videos.title: Invisible Muriel
videos.overview: Muriel whips up her secret recipe dog food for the County Dog Food Contest.

videos.title: Human Habitrail
videos.overview: A vacuum salesman shrinks Muriel and Eustace and sucks them up into his vacuum.

videos.title: Mission to the Sun
videos.overview: The family goes on a dangerous space mission to save the Sun.

videos.title: Courage the Fly
videos.overview: After being turned into a fly, Courage overhears military personnel discussing a satellite plunging to Earth.

videos.title: Katz Kandy
videos.overview: Katz returns to eliminate Muriel.

videos.title: Nowhere TV
videos.overview: The lottery is about to be announced, and Le Quack arrives.

videos.title: Mega Muriel the Magnificent
videos.overview: The Computer decides to take over Muriel's body to show the world what it can do.

videos.title: Bad Hair Day
videos.overview: Muriel is kidnapped and taken to a hair farm to be used for growing hair.

videos.title: The Forbidden Hat of Gold
videos.overview: Eustace takes the family on an adventure to find a hat worth millions.

videos.title: Serpent of Evil River
videos.overview: The family signs up for a free vacation but ends up having to serve as the ship's crew.

videos.title: The Transplant
videos.overview: Courage unearths a bone from a giant kangaroo.

videos.title: Car Broke, Phone Yes
videos.overview: A visitor on an alien mission extracts Muriel's kindness.

videos.title: Cowboy Courage
videos.overview: Courage dreams of being a brave lawman.

videos.title: Evil Weevil
videos.overview: Muriel invites a weevil to the farmhouse to recover from his injuries.

videos.title: McPhearson Phantom
videos.overview: A ghost harasses Muriel by sabotaging everything she does for Eustace.

videos.title: The House of Discontent
videos.overview: Eustace doesn't exchange crops for luck, and the house terrorizes the family.

videos.title: The Sand Whale Strikes
videos.overview: A sand whale arrives at the farm demanding his accordion.

videos.title: The Tower of Dr. Zalost
videos.overview: The miserable Dr. Zalost rains pink cannonballs down on the people of Nowhere, turning them gray and depressed.

videos.title: Muriel Meets Her Match
videos.overview: New neighbor Maria disguises herself as Muriel in order to steal a diamond.

videos.title: Courage vs. Mecha-Courage
videos.overview: Eustace replaces Courage with a technologically superior dog.

videos.title: Campsite of Terror
videos.overview: Muriel is kidnapped by two raccoons.

videos.title: Record Deal
videos.overview: Muriel becomes trapped in a record album.

videos.title: Stormy Weather
videos.overview: Muriel tries to stop a storm goddess from adopting Courage as her own dog.

videos.title: The Sandman Sleeps
videos.overview: The Sandman tries to use Muriel's sleep to cure his own insomnia.

videos.title: Hard Drive Courage
videos.overview: A computer virus captures Muriel while on the Internet.

videos.title: The Ride of the Valkyries
videos.overview: Muriel is mistaken for the leader of the Valkyries.

videos.title: Scuba-Scuba Doo
videos.overview: Muriel discovers tiny people while scuba diving.

videos.title: Conway the Contaminationist
videos.overview: A man with a filthy lifestyle contaminates the farmhouse.

videos.title: Katz Under the Sea
videos.overview: Muriel becomes the cook on a nuclear submarine.

videos.title: Curtain of Cruelty
videos.overview: A luminous curtain instills cruel behavior in Nowhere citizens.

videos.title: Feast of the Bullfrogs
videos.overview: Bullfrogs take over the farm.

videos.title: Tulip's Worm
videos.overview: A giant worm swallows Muriel and Eustace.

videos.title: So In Louvre Are We Two
videos.overview: Courage, Muriel and Eustace get locked into a French art museum at closing time.

videos.title: Night of the Scarecrow
videos.overview: A scarecrow appoints himself as Muriel's bodyguard.

videos.title: Mondo Magic
videos.overview: A monster-in-disguise wants to transform Muriel into his beastly bride.

videos.title: Watch the Birdies
videos.overview: A giant bird insists that Muriel baby-sit while she goes on vacation.

videos.title: Fishy Business
videos.overview: When the family is deemed uncivilized, they are forced to live underwater as fish.

videos.title: Angry Nasty People
videos.overview: Tarantella offers the family roles on his new show.

videos.title: Dome of Doom
videos.overview: Eustace signs up for a science experiment that covers the farm with a dome.

videos.title: Snowman's Revenge
videos.overview: The Snowman decides to make a West Pole, forcing the family to live in blistering cold.

videos.title: The Quilt Club
videos.overview: Muriel joins a mysterious quilt club.

videos.title: Swindlin' Wind
videos.overview: Angry at Eustace for cheating her, Shirley curses Eustace and Muriel.

videos.title: King of Flan
videos.overview: A flan infomercial hypnotizes the people of Nowhere.

videos.title: Courage Under the Volcano
videos.overview: Muriel is abducted by a tribe to become their human sacrifice.

videos.title: A Beaver's Tale
videos.overview: A beaver's huge dam forces water into the farmhouse.

videos.title: The Nutcracker
videos.overview: Rats capture Muriel and Eustace, preparing to cook them for a feast.

videos.title: Rumpledkiltskin
videos.overview: Muriel is summoned to Scotland to weave the family tartan.

videos.title: House Calls
videos.overview: A lonely scientist moves the farmhouse next to his mansion.

videos.title: Le Quack Balloon
videos.overview: Le Quack wants to use Muriel to rob the Piggy Bank of Sweden.

videos.title: Windmill Vandals
videos.overview: Courage tries to repair the farm's jammed windmill.

videos.title: The Uncommon Cold
videos.overview: Courage notices a strange creature in Muriel's sneezes.

videos.title: Farmer-Hunter, Farmer-Hunted
videos.overview: Eustace takes Courage on a deer-hunting trip.

videos.title: Bride of the Swamp Monster
videos.overview: A swamp monster believes Muriel is his long-lost-love.

videos.title: Goat Pain
videos.overview: In order to treat Muriel's back pain, the family must travel to a mountain spring.

videos.title: Muriel Blows Up
videos.overview: When Muriel eats a carrot covered in a mysterious residue, she begins to grow.

videos.title: Profiles in Courage
videos.overview: Cameo silhouettes steal Muriel and Eustace's souls.

videos.title: The Mask
videos.overview: A masked stranger who hates dogs arrives at the farm, beating Courage whenever possible.

videos.title: Squatting Tiger, Hidden Dog
videos.overview: Muriel is abducted during a tour of the Great Wall of China.

videos.title: Muted Muriel
videos.overview: Courage seeks Shirley's help when Muriel decides to stop talking.

videos.title: Aqua-Farmer
videos.overview: Eustace boasts that he can swim better than a dolphin.

videos.title: Food of the Dragon
videos.overview: A human-eating dragon arrives at the farmhouse and eats Eustace.

videos.title: The Last of the Starmakers
videos.overview: Muriel bonds with a star-making alien.

videos.title: Son of the Chicken from Outer Space
videos.overview: The three-headed son of the Chicken from Outer Space wants to avenge his father.

videos.title: Courageous Cure
videos.overview: Desperate to cure a disease, alien naturalists abduct Courage.

videos.title: Ball of Revenge
videos.overview: Courage is challenged to a game of dodgeball.

videos.title: Cabaret Courage
videos.overview: The family is offered great prizes to perform in an underground cabaret.

videos.title: Wrath of the Librarian
videos.overview: Courage returns a library book that is two years overdue.

videos.title: Remembrance of Courage Past
videos.overview: Courage becomes depressed after thinking of his parents.

videos.title: Perfect
videos.overview: Fed up with Courage's incompetence, Eustace seeks a professional dog trainer.
